name: niklas-skills
description: Claude skills I built to make my life easier, packaged to be shared and hopefully be beneficial to others.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Skills for the work around a pull request: reviewing your own diff before you open it, and running the gates the repo's own CI runs. Contains pr-preflight.

plugins.name: autonomous-work
plugins.description: Skills for work that runs while you're away: a deep alignment session, then an autonomous run with independent reviewers and a decision log instead of questions (afk), calibrated from your own transcripts and a blind backtest (taste-profile).

plugins.name: automation
plugins.description: Skills for automating real work with AI: find out what's blocking a process (access, context, guardrails) and design around it (automation-consultant), and let output face a board of critics before a human sees it (advisory-board).
